en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 19 in Mong Kok anti-illegal worker operation
en.dek: Seventeen women were detained for suspected breach of conditions of stay and two local men for allegedly employing people not lawfully employable during a joint raid on Monday.
body: Mong Kok police and Immigration Department officers conducted a joint operation codenamed Champion on Monday, targeting suspected illegal workers and related activities in the district. Nineteen people aged between 16 and 46 were arrested.

Seventeen women were detained on suspicion of violating conditions of stay. Two local men were arrested on suspicion of employing persons not lawfully employable. All those detained remain under investigation and will be handed over to the relevant departments for follow-up.

The Immigration Department reiterated that visitors are not permitted to take up employment in Hong Kong, paid or unpaid, without the permission of the Director of Immigration, and that offenders face prosecution.

zh.headline: 旺角反非法勞工行動拘19人 最細16歲
zh.dek: 警聯同入境處周一展開代號「冠軍」行動，17名女子涉違反逗留條件，兩名本地男子涉聘用不可合法受僱人士。
body: 旺角警區聯同入境事務處人員周一根據線報在區內展開代號「冠軍」的跨部門反非法入境者及非法勞工行動，突擊巡查多個地點，共拘捕19人，年齡介乎16至46歲。
其中17名女子涉嫌「違反逗留條件」被捕；另外兩名本地男子懷疑聘請非法勞工，涉嫌「僱用不可合法受僱的人」被捕。所有被捕人現正被扣留調查，稍後交由相關部門跟進。
入境處重申，旅客在未獲入境處處長批准前，無論受薪與否均不得在港從事任何僱傭工作，違者可被檢控。
